description: Modules in one package still carry docstrings and explanatory comments, against the rule that code is self-explaining.
goal: Remove every docstring and every comment that is not a '# why:' reason, a shebang, an encoding line or a tool directive (noqa, type, pragma, fmt) from the listed scope source files, without changing behaviour. Where a removed docstring or comment carried a reason the code cannot show, keep it as a '# why:' comment; where it only described what the code does, rename or extract so the code says it. Do not change any function signature, name used by another module, CLI help text, log or error message, or line budget. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Existing violations make the self-explaining rule untrue of the codebase; removing them one package at a time keeps every change small and behaviour-preserving.
acceptance_criteria: A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_self_doc_src_28.py parses each of these files with ast and tokenize and asserts it holds no docstring and no comment other than a '# why:' comment, a shebang, an encoding line or a noqa, type, pragma or fmt directive: apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/delta_review_request.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/git_identity.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/head_test_evidence.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/ids.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/ledger_commit.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/local_tests.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/merged_head_gate.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/merged_head_resume.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/merged_head_routing.py, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow/review/posting.py.
CLI `--help` text, `make help` output, and log or error messages are unchanged.
Each clean-up PR reports the before and after finding count for its slice.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes; no module budget changes.
